mapper.select: SELECT id FROM building WHERE ST_Distance_Sphere( geom, ST_SRID(POINT(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326) ) <= #{radiusMeters} ORDER BY ST_Distance_Sphere( geom, ST_SRID(POINT(#{longitude}, #{latitude}), 4326)) LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO building ( building_code, road_address, jibun_address, bld_nm, dong_nm, pnu, latitude, longitude ) VALUES ( #{buildingCode}, #{roadAddress}, #{jibunAddress}, #{bldNm}, #{dongNm}, #{pnu}, #{latitude}, #{longitude} )
